acceptance.actualText:
# Dominds / LTSP gateway joint check — 2026-10-31

Gateway-side checks, using the running ltspc16 instance. No deployment,
configuration update, credential rotation or paid inference was performed by
this side during discovery. Dominds owns the controlled real inference tests.

- SDK base URL: `http://172.16.100.254:8080/openai`.
- Responses and Chat Completions are registered; explicit
  `openai/gpt-6.1-terra` or `openai/gpt-6.1-sol` selects the OpenAI pool.
- Client authentication: current native Virtual Key named `ltsp-lan-clients`,
  available to trusted LAN management via GET `/api/governance/virtual-keys`.
  Test processes consume its value in memory; no secret is saved in this proof.
- Without authentication, GET `/openai/models` returned HTTP 401.
- With the shared key, GET `/openai/models` returned HTTP 200 and 130 model IDs;
  public response saved as `models.json`. Includes all five current GPT-6 family
  IDs discussed with Dominds. Listing alone does not establish paid usability or
  model capability, and includes older models.
- Authenticated GET `/openai/models/gpt-6.1-sol` and
  `/openai/models/openai/gpt-6.1-sol` both returned HTTP 200 with canonical
  `openai/gpt-6.1-sol`. This is metadata lookup, not inference routing evidence.
- Native OpenAI key: enabled, allowlist `*`, blacklist empty, weight 1,
  directory status `success`; one associated account group, not marked exhausted.
- Shared Virtual Key: active, no configured budget/rate limit. No upstream
  account RPM/TPM or remaining credit can be inferred from this configuration.
- Native OpenAI network settings: request timeout 300 seconds, stream idle
  timeout 120 seconds, retries 0; concurrency 1000, buffer 5000.

## Metadata sources and interpretation

The Bifrost model metadata APIs are:

- `/api/models/details?provider=openai&query=gpt-6.1&limit=30`
- `/api/models/parameters?model=gpt-6.1-terra`

Their upstream sources are `https://getbifrost.ai/datasheet` and
`https://getbifrost.ai/datasheet/model-parameters`, not authoritative OpenAI
capability contracts. Terra's details row reports max input 922000 and max
output 128000, whereas its parameter row reports max input 1050000 and includes
conflicting generic reasoning flags. Context window and maximum input are
different quantities; do not collapse these fields into a single capability.
Dominds should use official model pages for its global static table.

Official pages actually fetched here:

- https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/models/gpt-6.1-sol
- https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/prompt-caching

The Sol page specifies 1050000 context, 128000 maximum output and Responses API
for tool calling. The caching guide documents request-level
`prompt_cache_options.ttl` values `30m` and `12h`; the deployed LTSP middleware
fills only a missing TTL on supported Responses model families. A short prompt
does not prove cache reuse or the model's maximum context.

## Joint-test handoff

Connection details, public directory, source URLs, known limits and suggested
checks were delivered to Dominds chat
`01a187e2-21ae-70c3-91a4-a1390a7c40f2` through the existing native Desktop thread
channel, using the codex-thread-communication skill. Requests were accepted.
The Dominds side owns provider adapter/static-table changes and the small real
Responses streaming/tool/output-limit test set. Await its results before
claiming real-inference completion or making a gateway correction.

## First real inference — independently reconciled

Dominds reported a successful real `OpenAiGen` streamed Responses call using
`openai/gpt-6.1-terra`, reasoning `low`, no sampling parameters and no cache
field. The upstream created/completed events echoed
`prompt_cache_options={mode:implicit,ttl:12h}`. The short prompt's zero cache
counts do not assert cache reuse. Dominds public evidence is
`/tmp/dominds-ltsp-openai-67id4168/stream.json`.

Gateway log readback by exact ID `d3bed158-a4df-48a2-a1d8-639f4c34be2b`
returned exactly one row: success, provider `openai`, model `gpt-6.1-terra`,
object `responses_stream`; prompt 23, completion 8, total 31 tokens;
latency 3560.724 ms, estimated cost USD 0.000063. These match client usage.
Provider request ID: `req_4fa6b28b4f654cf2a5d7b7da47e21e0a`.
This confirms one real streaming route and default TTL adoption, not maximum
context, long output, quota, cache-hit behavior or yet-unfinished tool turns.

Dominds retains its existing product boundary of no output-token override;
the 128000 model limit comes from official documentation, not a large live
generation. Remaining controlled calls belong to the Dominds side.

## Real function round trip — independently reconciled

Dominds confirmed a streamed function request and a nonstreamed tool-result
continuation, using Terra with low reasoning. Random nonce arguments and a
separate receipt supplied only in the tool result were preserved; no external
tool was executed. Both responses echoed the low reasoning effort and 12h TTL.
Client evidence: `/tmp/dominds-ltsp-openai-67id4168/tools.json`.

| Gateway ID | Object | Input | Output | Estimated USD |
| --- | --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| `518fa6e2-a2f0-4425-b175-1e1332aee064` | responses_stream | 178 | 39 | 0.000373 |
| `7f8f4de5-a7e4-4cb6-8d47-a2a6a84ac9bb` | responses | 156 | 36 | 0.000336 |

Each exact ID returned one successful OpenAI/Terra log row, zero retries and
fallback index zero, with usage matching Dominds. All three real calls so far
total 357 input and 83 output tokens, estimated USD 0.000772. Each row's raw
request/response is an empty string and content_hidden is true. Sanitized
gateway evidence: `tool-roundtrip-gateway.json`.

This proves the tested Responses + low reasoning + function round trip; the
aggregate `supports_reasoning_with_tool_calls=false` flag must not be used to
deny that observed combination. Other APIs are not implied to share the result.

## Final joint-call reconciliation

All eight controlled real requests returned HTTP 200 and exactly one matching
successful gateway log row each. The four further short Responses calls used
`gpt-6.1-sol`, `gpt-6-astra`, `gpt-6-luna` and `gpt-6-sol`; each actual response
model and token usage matched the gateway. All calls used low reasoning.

The native SDK test requested `prompt_cache_options.ttl=30m` and
`max_output_tokens=256`; the upstream echoed 30m, confirming the default 12h did
not override it. This validates the SDK wire option, not a new Dominds product
parameter. The seven requests omitting the cache field echoed 12h.

Total: 464 input + 117 output tokens = 581 tokens; estimated USD 0.0016348.
All eight gateway rows had retries 0, fallback index 0, content_hidden true and
empty raw request/response strings. No provider key, gateway setting, binary or
controller image changed for this joint check. No gateway correction is needed
for the tested flows.

Complete sanitized reconciliation is in `joint-reconciliation.json`. The seven
client JSON files containing eight requests were copied under `client/` after
verifying credentialStored=false and no credential-like values. They preserve
the short stream, function round trip, four short model calls and explicit TTL
check without depending on the original temporary directory. Global static
model definitions and provider example changes remain owned by Dominds.

The calls do not establish maximum context/output, visual behavior, cache hits,
throughput, account quota, Chat Completions tools or other untested combinations.

limitations: No actual image input, visual quality, writing/reasoning quality or task-quality benchmark.
No long prompt, cache-hit/rate/cost-saving or TTL-duration wait experiment.
No claim that all 130 catalog entries support execution-agent chat.
No bare-ID inference, Chat Completions or non-low effort inference coverage.
Only the dedicated SDK TTL probe sets max_output_tokens; existing Dominds team parameters remain unchanged.
